title: Визит шейха и мороженое из коньяка  (The Sheikh's Visit and Cognac Ice Cream)

scenes.title: A Very Wealthy Guest
scenes.summary: A wealthy Arab sheikh books the entire Boutique Hotel Eleon, arriving with his entourage and a wave of rumors.

scenes.title: Rumors About the Sheikh's Ring
scenes.summary: Fedya tells the cooks how a waiter received a priceless ring from the sheikh last year, while Nastya shares a darker rumor about a missing waitress.

scenes.title: Dreams of a Dacha and Pear with Cheese
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya daydream about winning the sheikh's huge ring while Max teases Kostya that the sheikh might kidnap Nastya.

scenes.title: The Chef Takes Over the Order
scenes.summary: The sheikh sends back Senya and Fedya's dish untouched, and Chef Barinov decides to remake the baked pear himself.

scenes.title: Prisoner in a Golden Cage
scenes.summary: Barinov delivers the dish to room 205 and accidentally sees one of the sheikh's wives undressed—a Russian girl who blackmails him into bringing her a drink.

scenes.title: A Date Invitation from the Sheikh
scenes.summary: The sheikh's interpreter tells Nastya that His Highness wants to meet her closely; Nastya refuses and uses the invitation to make Kostya jealous.

scenes.title: Cognac Ice Cream
scenes.summary: Barinov asks Katya how to smuggle cognac upstairs, and Katya uses liquid nitrogen to freeze cognac into molecular ice cream.

scenes.title: Seconds for Room Two-Oh-Five
scenes.summary: Yulya loves the cognac ice cream and orders a second helping, while Senya and Fedya misread Katya's hand gesture and think she got the ring.

scenes.title: Heart-to-Heart with the Sheikh's Wife
scenes.summary: Kostya notices that Nastya is nowhere to be found, while upstairs a tipsy Yulya tells Katya how lonely life is inside a golden cage.

scenes.title: A Dangerous Role Swap
scenes.summary: Yulya blackmails Katya into putting on her veil and pretending to be the sheikh's wife for an hour while Yulya sneaks out to the Metropol.

scenes.title: Katya Is Summoned to the Sheikh's Dinner
scenes.summary: Katya calls her father in a panic after Yulya leaves, and moments later a guard knocks on the suite door to summon 'Yulya' to dinner.

scenes.title: The Sheikh's Plans After Dinner
scenes.summary: The interpreter tells disguised Katya that the sheikh wants to visit her room after dinner, while Kostya searches the storage rooms for Nastya.

scenes.title: Timur's Urgent Mission
scenes.summary: Max relays Katya's SOS to Chef Barinov, who dispatches Timur to the Metropol to fetch Yulya while preparing halal lamb to stall the sheikh.

scenes.title: A Gift from Nastya's Parents
scenes.summary: While Kostya fears that Nastya was taken into the sheikh's harem, Nastya is outside receiving a surprise SUV from her parents.

scenes.title: Chocolate Fondant and Buying Time
scenes.summary: Nastya refuses her father's SUV because of its exhaust emissions, while Barinov orders Louis to bake another chocolate fondant so he can stall the sheikh.

scenes.title: The Chef's Culinary Magic Tricks
scenes.summary: Barinov performs ridiculous culinary tricks for the sheikh until a cherry tomato flies into the sheikh's throat, just as Timur returns with Yulya.

scenes.title: The Interpreter's Deception
scenes.summary: Kostya bursts into a room looking for Nastya and catches the sheikh's interpreter with waitress Alisa, learning that Nastya rejected the interpreter.

scenes.title: Apologies to the Sheikh
scenes.summary: Max exposes the interpreter to the sheikh in English, the sheikh fires the interpreter, and the kitchen crew profusely apologizes.

scenes.title: Max Stands Up for Vika
scenes.summary: Katya is safe after Yulya returns to the sheikh, and when Mikhail yells at Vika over the tomato incident, Max stands up for his wife.
